comment: The suite skips this module because id_token_signing_alg_values_supported does not include 'none'; OPs are not required to support unsigned ID Tokens, and the toolkit deliberately does not.

The suite skips this module because subject_types_supported does not include 'pairwise'; OpenID Connect Core 8 makes the pairwise subject type optional, and the toolkit only issues public subject identifiers.
Same as oidcc-registration-sector-uri: no pairwise subject type, so there is no sector_identifier_uri to validate.
